questions.category: B3 — Maintain automated and CNC equipment
questions.question: What should be checked regularly on CNC guide rails and lead screws?
questions.explanation: CNC movement depends on clean, lubricated, accurate motion parts. Wear or debris can cause poor cuts and machine damage.

questions.question: What is the purpose of cleaning spray gun fluid passages after use?
options: To prevent clogging and poor spray pattern
questions.explanation: Finish residue can harden inside the gun. Cleaning keeps the spray pattern consistent and prevents equipment problems.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of a production jig?
questions.explanation: Jigs locate parts consistently for repeated operations. They reduce setup time and variation.

questions.question: What is the purpose of building a prototype before full production?
options: To test design, fit, function, and process
questions.explanation: Prototypes reveal problems before production. They help confirm construction details and performance.

questions.category: G1 — Set up automated and CNC equipment
questions.question: What must be confirmed before running a CNC program?
options: Tooling, origin, material thickness, and hold-down
questions.explanation: CNC setup errors can ruin material or damage tools. Origin, tooling, and hold-down must be verified first.
